description: This file defines a React component 'AllModelsTab' for managing and displaying a list of models with filtering, searching, and pagination features within a dashboard interface. It includes hooks for user authorization, team management, and UI controls for selecting teams, view modes, filters, and search terms. The component consolidates model data filtering, pagination, and rendering a data table.

methods.name: AllModelsTab
methods.description: React functional component that renders a tab panel with model filtering, search, and data table for user interaction within a dashboard.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters, search terms, and view modes to their default states.
